subject: FinLytics MAP: SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA — data retention clarifications and close timeline
messages:
From: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@finlytics.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: security@finlytics.com
Date: 2028-03-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: FinLytics MAP kickoff: initial evidence and retention questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. FinLytics is excited to start the MAP for the Redwood integration. Our security team asked that we kick off the evidence collection and clarify the data retention expectations in the DPA before we move to a pilot. High-level asks: 

- SOC 2: We need either a SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months or a bridge letter plus the testing window and date.
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll be sending the SIG spreadsheet. Please confirm which sections Redwood will complete versus which we should validate by evidence.
- DPA: two items need clarity for our legal team: (1) data retention windows for customer personal data and logs, and (2) subprocessors list + notification cadence for changes.

Can you propose a short MAP with milestones (SIG return, SOC evidence upload, DPA redline completion) and an expected close timeline? We are aiming for a pilot start in mid-April if feasible.

I can act as the primary contact here. Attaching a template SIG spreadsheet (we'll send the full file once we have the access point).

Thanks,
Elena Roberts
Head of Product Security | FinLytics
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@finlytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-24T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics MAP kickoff: initial evidence and retention questions

Elena —

Thanks, and great to meet you. Below is a proposed MAP focused strictly on the security/compliance gates you called out. I've kept each milestone small so we can track progress and avoid blockers: 

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Week 0 (today): FinLytics shares SIG spreadsheet + any target DPA redlines.
- Week 1–2: Redwood completes SOC 2 artifacts upload (report or bridge letter) + clears SIG sections A–F.
- Week 2–3: Legal review / DPA redline exchange (we'll comment on retention and subprocessors).
- Week 3: Final acceptance of security gate (SOC 2 + SIG validation + signed DPA) => pilot kickoff (limited traffic).

Open questions we need from you to finalize: 
1) Retention scope — confirm the retention window you expect for: 
   - Customer personal data (PII) after contract termination (typical options: 30d / 90d / 1yr).
   - Application logs (auth / access logs) — do you require longer retention for audit (e.g., 1–3 years)?
2) SOC evidence — please confirm whether a Type II is available; if not, a bridge letter plus last test window is acceptable.
3) SIG — which sections would you like Redwood to complete first? Our suggestion: complete SIG areas around Access Control, Encryption, and Data Flows first (these usually unblock audit validation).

Attachments: I attached a stub SOC 2 index and a suggested SIG completion plan. We'll also provide a secure upload link for evidence.

If that looks good, Priyom will coordinate the timelines with your procurement/legal team.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@finlytics.com>, michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-25T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics MAP kickoff: initial evidence and retention questions

Elena / Michael —

Looping in legal here with a few clarifying preferences so your counsel can see Redwood's starting position. High-level DPA notes: 

- Retention windows: Redwood's standard is to purge customer PII 90 days after contract termination unless there is an agreed-upon archival obligation (e.g., legal hold). For audit/logging data, we typically retain aggregated telemetry for 12 months and access/auth logs for up to 24 months; we can negotiate a longer retention period for audit purposes with a clear purpose and scope statement.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a current subprocessor list and notify customers within 30 days of material additions.
- Data subject requests (DSRs): Redwood will process DSRs per the DPA timeline — typically within 30 days of receipt; exceptional requests requiring legal review may take longer but will be communicated.
- Encryption/Key management: We propose KMS integration for customers with elevated requirements; we'll include an option in the MAP to discuss KMS/HSM integration timing if FinLytics requires customer-managed keys.

Request for you: please confirm whether the 90-day PII purge is acceptable as a baseline and whether FinLytics requires any extended archive window for retention of transactional records. Also, if you have regulatory requirements (e.g., FFIEC, GDPR articles) that mandate specific retention horizons, flag them so we can add carveouts.

If helpful I can prepare a short memo with alternate retention scenarios (30/90/365 days) and the operational implications for evidence and restore capabilities.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@finlytics.com>, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-28T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics MAP kickoff: initial evidence and retention questions

Elena — quick operational note on the timeline so FinLytics procurement can plan: 

- SIG: If you can return the completed SIG within 10 business days, Redwood will prioritize Sections 1–6 and provide supporting artifacts. We typically complete SIG validation against our evidence repository in 3 business days once we have the inputs.
- SOC: If you can confirm whether Type II is available by EOW, we'll slot the evidence upload window. If it's a bridge letter, please include the last test date so we can capture scope alignment.
- DPA: Redwood legal will produce DPA redline (v2) and propose the 90-day PII purge baseline (see Kimberly's note). We expect DPA negotiation to take ~5–7 business days for standard commercial terms.

I propose the following close timeline if all goes to plan:
- SIG returned: by 2028-04-09
- SOC evidence upload: by 2028-04-05 (or earlier if Type II exists)
- DPA finalization: by 2028-04-12
- Pilot start: 2028-04-15 (limited to internal accounts, throttled)

We can also arrange a shared SFTP or gated Drive folder for evidence; please let us know which you prefer. Attached: SIG_CAIC_worksheet.xlsx (stub).

Regards,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@finlytics.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: security@finlytics.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-30T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics MAP kickoff: initial evidence and retention questions

Michael / Priyom / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear MAP. We can work to the timelines you suggested with a few confirmations: 

- SOC: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period ended 2027-12-31). We'll upload the report and the control matrix by 2028-04-04.
- SIG: We'll return the completed SIG spreadsheet to your shared Drive by 2028-04-09. For the SIG, FinLytics expects Redwood to complete Access Control, Encryption, Data Flow diagrams, and Incident Response sections.
- DPA / retention: FinLytics legal will accept a 90-day PII purge baseline for standard customer data. However, we will request a 3-year retention carveout for audit logs relevant to transaction reconciliation (we can scope this to specific log classes). We'll send DPA redlines by COB 2028-04-02; please have legal confirm the carveout handling in their redline.

We prefer the gated Drive upload. I'll share access once you send the invite. Last ask: can Redwood include an annotation in the MAP that SOC scope includes infrastructure and the inference runtime (model serving)? That will help FinLytics security validate the report against expected scope.

If we stick to the plan above, pilot start on 2028-04-15 works for us.

Best,
Elena Roberts
Head of Product Security | FinLytics
